d: a pulsar is a neutron star spinning at incredible speed, sending beams of radiation across space like a lighthouse. if one points your way, you wouldn't want to be there. in reality, pulsars are far away and predictable. in my game, one appears where it doesn't belong. no solar system, no jupiter. just endless darkness and a rotating pulsar that shouldn't exist. you don't know if it's real. this is part of "God Sized" - my space horror game about astrophobia. i can't say more, spoilers. more updates in my discord, link in bio #pulsar #star #solarsystem #space #game #indiegamedev #gamedev #indiehorror #gamedevelopment #fyr #dev #jupiter #godot #godotengine #геймдев #делаюигру #разработкаигры #foryou #fyp #космос #игры

d: In some parts of Southeast Asia, people believe the dead can return… still wrapped in their burial cloth. The Pocong is one of the most well-known spirits in Indonesian and Malaysian folklore. According to local beliefs, it is the ghost of a person who was buried in a traditional funeral shroud and whose spirit was unable to move on. In these burials, the body is wrapped tightly in white cloth and tied at the head, neck, and feet. Legends say that if the ties are not properly released after burial, the spirit may become trapped and return as a Pocong. Because its legs are bound by the cloth, the Pocong is often described as moving by hopping rather than walking. Many people claim to have seen these white figures at night near graveyards, forests, or abandoned roads. Even though there is no scientific evidence, the legend continues to be one of the most famous paranormal stories in Southeast Asia.
zh: 在东南亚部分地区，人们相信死者会回来……仍裹着裹尸布。裹尸布幽灵是印尼和马来西亚民间传说中最广为人知的鬼怪之一。据当地信仰，它是被传统裹尸布下葬后灵魂无法超度之人的鬼魂。下葬时遗体被白布紧紧包裹，头部、颈部和脚部均用绳子绑扎。传说若下葬后绳结未被妥善解开，灵魂便可能被困住并化为裹尸布幽灵归来。由于双腿被布束缚，裹尸布幽灵通常被描述为以跳跃而非行走的方式移动。许多人声称曾在夜间于墓地、森林或废弃道路旁目击这些白色身影。尽管缺乏科学依据，这一传说至今仍是东南亚最著名的灵异故事之一。

d: The Aswang is one of the most feared creatures in Filipino folklore. By day, it looks like an ordinary person, blending into villages unnoticed. But at night, it transforms into a terrifying predator that hunts humans, especially pregnant women and young children. Legends say the Aswang can separate its upper body from its lower half, sprout bat-like wings, and use a long, hollow tongue to feed on its victims from rooftops. For centuries, stories of the Aswang have been passed down across the Philippines, making it one of the world’s most infamous cryptids and supernatural beings. #folklore #filipino #aswang #fyp #viral
zh: 阿斯旺是菲律宾民间传说中最令人闻风丧胆的生物之一。白天，它看起来与普通人无异，悄无声息地混入村庄。但一到夜晚，它便化身为恐怖的猎食者，专门猎杀人类，尤其是孕妇和幼童。传说阿斯旺能将上半身与下半身分离，长出蝙蝠般的翅膀，并用细长中空的舌头从屋顶吸食受害者。数百年来，有关阿斯旺的故事在菲律宾各地代代相传，使其成为世界上最臭名昭著的神秘生物与超自然存在之一。

d: Reyna Manalo observed a creature from her window at approximately 10 PM, in the Pampanga Province in the Philippines. Regional documentation  identifies the creature as an Aswang — a shape-shifting entity. Reyna stated, “It was as if it was looking right into my soul with those yellow beady eyes.” The creature was standing upright outside her window and appeared to be gesturing for her to come outside. Reyna applied a traditional coconut oil preparation reported in regional documentation to have protective properties against Aswang contact. The beast retreated shortly after the oil was administered. #aswang #philippines #folklore #cryptid #paranormal

d: Not horror. Not myth. In the Philippines, people still whisper “tabi-tabi po” before passing an old tree. Engkanto aren’t ghosts — they’re guardians of the land. 🌿 Pre-colonial stories said they protected balance between humans and nature — long before the Spanish called them demons. Some legends never die… they just evolve #Engkanto #PhilippineMythology #FilipinoFolklore #PinoyCulture #TabiTabiPo
zh: 这不是恐怖故事，也不是迷信。在菲律宾，人们经过老树时仍会低声说"借过了"。恩坎托不是鬼魂，而是大地的守护者。殖民前的故事说它们维护着人与自然的平衡，远在西班牙人称其为恶魔之前。有些传说永不消亡，只是不断演变。

zh: 张小元是一位中国壁画艺术家，以创作与周围环境直接互动的错觉壁画而闻名。他不将墙面视为平面，而是将壁画与真实物体、树木、枝条及建筑细节融为一体，让环境成为作品的一部分。艺术家：张小元 / 抖音账号 ZXY698

d: Daidai is a Chinese relief mural artist known for transforming walls into sculptural landscapes. Her large-scale works blend carving, modeling, and painting, creating immersive three-dimensional scenes that capture depth and light. One of her most striking creations depicts the Great Wall of China, where layered textures and shadows bring the ancient monument to life. Each detail reflects her dedication to preserving cultural heritage through modern craftsmanship. Artist: 戴戴 浮雕壁画师 / 67383829971 on Douyin #art #artist #painting #sculpture
zh: 戴戴是一位中国浮雕壁画师，擅长将墙面转化为立体景观。她的大型作品融合雕刻、塑形与绘画，营造出极具沉浸感的三维场景，展现深度与光影之美。其中最震撼的作品之一是以长城为主题的壁画，层次丰富的肌理与光影让这座古老建筑焕发生机。每一处细节都体现了她以现代工艺传承文化遗产的心血。艺术家：戴戴 浮雕壁画师 / 抖音账号 67383829971

d: Los gatos maúllan por muchas razones, y cada maullido parece tener su propio significado. Algunos maúllan para saludar a sus humanos cuando llegan a casa, mientras que otros maúllan cuando quieren comida, atención o jugar. Con el tiempo, muchos dueños de gatos aprenden a reconocer los diferentes sonidos que hacen sus gatos y lo que cada uno intenta decir. Una de las cosas más interesantes de los gatos es que a menudo maúllan más a las personas que a otros gatos. El maullido es una forma especial en que los gatos se comunican con los humanos, casi como si hubieran desarrollado su propio lenguaje para llamar nuestra atención. Algunos gatos son silenciosos y solo maúllan ocasionalmente, mientras que otros parecen tener largas conversaciones con sus familias todos los días. El maullido de un gato también puede revelar sus emociones. Un maullido suave y delicado puede mostrar afecto o curiosidad, mientras que un maullido fuerte y repetido podría significar que el gato está emocionado, impaciente o intentando decirle algo importante a su dueño. Ya sea que pidan golosinas, quieran un abrazo o simplemente saluden, el maullido de un gato es una de las muchas maneras en que estas adorables mascotas se conectan con las personas en las que confían. #cat #catslovers #catsoftiktok #catshorts #parati
zh: 猫咪叫声背后的秘密：它们用喵喵声和人类沟通，每种叫声都有不同含义——有的是打招呼，有的是要食物或玩耍。有趣的是，猫对人叫的次数远多于对其他猫。轻柔的叫声表示亲昵或好奇，响亮而重复的叫声则可能表示兴奋或急迫。无论是要零食、要抱抱还是只是问候，喵喵叫都是猫咪与信任之人建立联系的方式之一。

Stimulasi bayi baru lahir adalah bagian dari prosedur resusitasi neonatal, yaitu teknik lembut yang dilakukan oleh dokter atau perawat segera setelah bayi lahir jika bayi tidak bernapas atau menangis dengan baik. Teknik ini melibatkan penggosokan atau penepukan ringan pada dada, punggung, atau telapak kaki bayi. Tujuannya adalah untuk mendorong bayi mengambil napas pertama dan membantu mengeluarkan cairan dari paru-paru. Stimulasi ini sama sekali tidak berbahaya dan merupakan praktik medis standar yang hanya digunakan saat diperlukan, yaitu untuk membantu bayi mulai bernapas secara mandiri. Prosedur ini juga berperan penting dalam penentuan Skor APGAR, yang digunakan untuk menilai kondisi vital bayi seperti detak jantung, pernapasan, dan tonus otot, sesaat setelah kelahiran. d: Taking care of these cats had brought me bliss and peace. These were just strays that we adopted. Luna was found on the streets, Majin was, too. Peachy was given by a friend. Among these three, only Peachy has a mix of Persian breeds, but she's a Puspin(pusang pinoy) by heart. Just like Luna and Majin. Puspins usually eat food that we humans eat. We usually give them leftovers. Mostly rice and sabaw. But since Luna got sick, I've been searching for an affordable cat food and treats to make her eat better and have the nutrients she needs.  The cat food and treats had made significant changes to their weight, coat and their overall appearance. Now, their food has been added to our weekly budget. And they are all worth it
zh: 照顾这些猫给我带来了幸福与平静。它们都是我们收养的流浪猫。Luna是在街上捡到的，Majin也是。Peachy是朋友送的。三只里只有Peachy有波斯猫血统，但她骨子里是土生猫，和Luna、Majin一样。土生猫通常吃我们人类的食物，一般喂剩饭，大多是米饭和汤。自从Luna生病后，我一直在寻找价格实惠的猫粮和零食，让她吃得更好、补充所需营养。猫粮和零食让它们的体重、毛发和整体状态都有了明显改善。现在，它们的伙食已经纳入我们每周的预算，一切都值得。

d: Batangas Vlog! 🐶🐾 Ang munting bakasyon ng furbebi na may altapresyon 😝 #dogsoftiktok #minivlog  ‼️ Hello mga bes!! May ika-clarify lang po kami para iwas confusion na din sa mga followers namin na naengganyo magbook sa place. May naoverlooked kami sa rules and regulations dito  during ng stay namin. At yun ay bawal po ang PET sa BED. Small dogs lang din po ang allowed sa loob ng cottage (in case may furbaby kayo na gusto isama sa check in na medium - large breed) It was an honest mistake sa side namin mga bes kasi kung nabasa namin yun prior ng check in ay hindi kami tutuloy dahil katabi namin talaga mag sleep sina Chopper and Kaidae. Due to intense excitement ay hindi namin nabasa lahat yung rules and regulations under 'other policies' na sinend prior ng booking.  Based on our experience kasi sa mga past bookings namin sa mga pet friendly staycation ay wala restriction sa pag akyat ng pet sa bed. Gayunpaman, eto pa rin ay pagkakamali sa side namin. 🥹 Dinelete namin ang raw video ng pag-akyat ni Chopper and Kaidae sa higaan para hindi na gayahin ng ibang furparents na binabalak isama ang kanilang furbabies. The management is kind enough to let us keep this vlog bilang memories ng staycation namin with our furbabies. We genuinely apologize for the mistake. 🙏 🐾
zh: 巴丹加斯度假Vlog！高血压毛宝贝的小度假。大家好！有些事情需要说明一下，避免误导想预订该地点的粉丝。我们在入住期间忽略了一条规定：禁止宠物上床，且小屋内只允许携带小型犬。这是我们的失误，如果事先看到这条规定，我们不会成行，因为我们平时就和Chopper、Kaidae睡在一起。由于太兴奋，我们没有仔细阅读预订前发送的"其他政策"中的所有条款。我们已删除Chopper和Kaidae上床的原始视频，以免其他铲屎官效仿。管理方好意允许我们保留这段Vlog作为纪念。我们真诚道歉。

d: Pet grief among sibling pets is SO REAL. Navigating through my own grief after sweet LeLe's unexpected passing in late 2022 was complex; however, I certainly never prepared myself for Cappy's emotions. Cappy's agonizing cries in despair broke me.  LeLe was my first (pet) loss. There wasn't a textbook to teach this stuff. I wanted to cry and wallow in my bed for days at a time, but then there was precious Cappy in distress for sweet LeLe. Scott and I went into overdrive making sure cappy felt loved and so special. But cappy was devastated.  LeLe welcomed cappy bear home with open arms to our family 7 years ago. They were such special brothers. Despite being blind, LeLe trusted cappy from the start. Our hearts will never heal fully from the devastating loss, but our hearts will continue to make room for more love to give.  #rainbowbridgeremembranceday #petgrief #specialbond
zh: 宠物之间的悲伤是真实存在的。2022年底，亲爱的LeLe突然离世，我自己的悲痛就已难以承受，更没想到Cappy也会有如此强烈的情绪。Cappy痛苦的哀鸣彻底击垮了我。LeLe是我第一个失去的宠物，没有任何经验可循。我想整日躲在床上哭泣，但Cappy也在为LeLe悲伤。我和Scott全力以赴让Cappy感受到爱与关怀，但它仍然深受打击。七年前，正是LeLe张开双臂欢迎Cappy加入我们的家庭，它们是如此特别的兄弟。尽管LeLe是盲猫，却从一开始就信任Cappy。这份沉重的失去让我们的心无法完全愈合，但我们的心会继续为更多的爱腾出空间。

d: Joget adalah aktivitas menggerakkan tubuh mengikuti irama musik secara bebas, spontan, dan penuh ekspresi. Joget tidak terikat oleh aturan baku seperti tarian tradisional atau koreografi profesional, sehingga setiap orang bisa melakukannya dengan gaya masing-masing sesuai suasana hati dan jenis musik yang didengar. Sejak awal peradaban manusia, joget sudah menjadi bagian dari kehidupan. Ketika manusia purba mulai mengenal bunyi-bunyian dari alam seperti tepukan tangan, hentakan kaki, atau suara alat sederhana, mereka secara alami menggerakkan tubuh mengikuti ritme tersebut. Aktivitas ini awalnya digunakan dalam ritual kepercayaan, perayaan hasil panen, hingga sebagai sarana komunikasi dan kebersamaan dalam kelompok. Seiring berkembangnya zaman, joget mengalami perubahan fungsi. Dari yang awalnya bersifat sakral dan ritual, joget menjadi bentuk hiburan yang lebih santai dan universal. Di berbagai budaya, joget muncul dalam bentuk yang berbeda-beda, mengikuti karakter musik dan kebiasaan masyarakat setempat. Hingga kini, joget menjadi bagian dari gaya hidup modern, terutama dengan hadirnya media sosial seperti TikTok yang membuat berbagai gaya joget viral dan mudah ditiru. Kesimpulannya, joget adalah cara sederhana manusia mengekspresikan diri melalui gerakan tubuh yang mengikuti irama musik, yang telah ada sejak zaman dahulu dan terus berkembang menjadi bagian penting dari hiburan hingga saat ini. . #PUBGMIDStar2026  #PUBGM430  #PUBGM8ANNI  #PUBGM  #PUBGMOBILE  #PUBGMAncientsecret  #8eyondtheCircle  #pubgmnextstarprogram #PUBGMS29  #ASGAME  #GamingOnTikTok  #JohenGaming

zh: 跳舞是一种随着音乐节奏自由、自发、充满表情地活动身体的活动。跳舞不像传统舞蹈或专业编舞那样受到固定规则的束缚，每个人都可以根据自己的心情和所听音乐的类型以自己的方式跳舞。自人类文明之初，跳舞就已成为生活的一部分。当远古人类开始接触自然界的声音，如拍手声、跺脚声或简单乐器的声音时，他们自然地随着节奏活动身体。这种活动最初被用于宗教仪式、庆祝丰收，以及作为群体交流和凝聚的手段。随着时代的发展，跳舞的功能也发生了变化，从最初的神圣仪式性质，演变为更轻松、更普遍的娱乐形式。在各种文化中，跳舞以不同的形式出现，遵循当地音乐特色和社会习惯。时至今日，跳舞已成为现代生活方式的一部分，尤其是随着TikTok等社交媒体的出现，各种舞蹈风格得以迅速传播且易于模仿。总之，跳舞是人类通过随音乐节奏活动身体来表达自我的简单方式，自古以来就已存在，并持续发展成为当今娱乐的重要组成部分。

d: Video latihan tari di Sanggar Pradnya Swari, Jembrana, Bali, viral di media sosial. Anak-anak yang berlatih—baik laki-laki maupun perempuan—tampak serius menguasai nyeledet, gerak mata khas dalam tari Bali. Nyeledet bukan sekadar melirik, tetapi gerakan cepat dan tajam yang harus selaras dengan ekspresi wajah, posisi kepala, dan irama gamelan. Teknik ini dikenal sulit karena membutuhkan konsentrasi tinggi serta kontrol otot mata yang kuat. Merujuk kajian seniman dan akademisi tari Bali, I Wayan Dibia, nyeledet menjadi elemen penting dalam membangun karakter tarian seperti Legong dan Kebyar, sekaligus menunjukkan kedalaman ekspresi penari. zh: 巴厘岛金布拉纳Pradnya Swari舞蹈学院的练习视频在社交媒体上走红。无论男女，学员们都在认真练习巴厘传统舞蹈中标志性的眼部动作"nyeledet"。Nyeledet并非简单的斜视，而是需要与面部表情、头部姿势和甘美兰音乐节奏高度协调的快速而犀利的眼部动作。巴厘舞蹈艺术家及学者I Wayan Dibia指出，这一技法是Legong、Kebyar等舞蹈塑造人物的关键要素，也体现了舞者表达的深度。视频中，孩子们反复练习以求精准，这一过程展现了台上令人叹为观止的巴厘舞蹈背后漫长的磨练历程。

d: The Traditional Dance of Bali: Legong Explained Legong is one of Bali’s most iconic and sacred traditional dances, known for its intricate eye movements, graceful hand gestures, and deep cultural meaning. Unlike modern dance trends, Legong requires years of training, often starting as early as five years old. Originally performed by young girls in royal courts, the dance symbolizes purity, discipline, and spiritual devotion—often as an offering to the gods during temple ceremonies. Today, men are also learning Legong, helping to preserve and evolve this art form for future generations. Every movement in Legong tells a story, usually drawn from ancient Hindu epics, making it more than just a dance—it’s a living expression of Balinese identity and heritage.  #bali #culture #traditionaldance #traditional #culturalheritage #dance #folkdance #culturaldiversitycostume #shorts #interestingshorts #uniqueshorts
h: bali, culture, traditionaldance, traditional, culturalheritage, dance, folkdance, culturaldiversitycostume, shorts, interestingshorts, uniqueshorts
zh: 巴厘传统舞蹈：Legong详解。Legong是巴厘最具代表性的神圣传统舞蹈之一，以复杂的眼部动作、优美的手势和深厚的文化内涵著称。与现代流行舞蹈不同，Legong需要多年训练，通常从五岁便开始学习。它最初由年轻女孩在王室宫廷中表演，象征纯洁、纪律与精神虔诚，常作为庙会仪式中献给神明的供奉。如今，男性也开始学习Legong，助力这一艺术形式的传承与发展。Legong的每个动作都在讲述故事，素材通常取自古印度史诗，使其不仅是一支舞蹈，更是巴厘身份认同与文化遗产的活态表达。

d: One tiny word you'll hear everywhere in Thai: กัน (gan) When you put it after a verb, it often means "Let's..." 🍚 กินข้าวกัน (gin khâao gan) = Let's eat. ✈️ ไปเที่ยวกัน (bpai thîao gan) = Let's go out. / Let's travel. 🎬 ดูหนังกัน (duu nǎng gan) = Let's watch a movie. 📸 ถ่ายรูปกัน (thàai-rûup gan) = Let's take a picture. 🏠 กลับบ้านกัน (glàp bâan gan) = Let's go home. Simple, natural, and something Thai people say every day. 🇹🇭#thailanguage #thai #thailand #thaiculture #learnontiktok
zh: 泰语中随处可听到的一个小词：กัน（gan），放在动词后面通常表示"一起……"，例如：一起吃饭、一起出去玩、一起看电影、一起拍照、一起回家。简单自然，是泰国人每天都会说的表达。

d: Cabai pedas + bawang putih gurih dimasak perlahan sampai garing🧄✨ Begitu denger suara kriuknya, langsung bikin nagih!  ‼️TIPS biar makin garing & tahan lama: Iris bawang putih dan cabainya harus tipis! Saat menggoreng, apinya juga jangan terlalu besar ya. Cocok banget buat stok di toples, bisa jadi teman makan atau lauk dadakan!🤤 🌶️ Bahan: 10 siung bawang putih, iris 10 buah cabai rawit merah, iris 5 buah cabai merah keriting, iris 2 sdm tepung terigu  6 sdm tepung pati jagung 50 ml air 1 sdt terasi, sangrai Garam sesuai selera Kaldu jamur sesuai selera Minyak untuk menggoreng Cara Membuat: 1. Siapkan mangkuk, masukkan irisan bawang putih, cabai rawit, dan cabai keriting, aduk rata. 2. Masukkan tepung terigu, tepung pati jagung, dan sedikit air. Aduk sampai semua terbalur rata. 3. Panaskan minyak untuk menggoreng, masukkan campuran bawang dan cabai sedikit demi sedikit.  4. Goreng sampai kecoklatan dan garing. Tiriskan, lalu masukkan ke dalam wadah. 5. d: Nasi Goreng Indonesia - Indonesian Fried Rice #friedrice #easyrecipes #recipe  Ingredients 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 egg 3 cups cooked rice 4 slices fish cake, thinly sliced 4 large prawns, peeled and deveined A handful of fresh squid, cleaned and sliced 1 tbsp light soy sauce 2 tbsp kecap manis (sweet soy sauce) 1 tsp dark caramel sauce 1 tbsp sambal (adjust to taste) Large pinch of YumYum or MSG 1 bird’s eye chili, finely sliced 1 spring onion, thinly sliced 2 tbsp fried garlic Sliced cucumber and tomato, to serve Fried egg, to serve INSTRUCTIONS 1. Heat a wok over high heat and add a splash of oil. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry until fragrant. 2. Crack in the egg and scramble it quickly, breaking it into small pieces as it cooks. 3. Add the cooked rice to the wok and toss thoroughly, breaking up any clumps and ensuring it’s well-coated in the egg and garlic mixture. 4. Add the fish cake, prawns, and squid. Toss everything together and stir-fry until the seafood is cooked through. 5. Mix in the light soy sauce, kecap manis, dark caramel sauce, and sambal. Stir well to evenly coat the rice and proteins with the sauce. 6. Toss in the bird’s eye chili and sliced spring onion. Stir-fry briefly to combine. 7. Sprinkle the fried garlic over the rice and give it one final toss. 8. Serve hot, garnished with sliced cucumber and tomato, and top with a fried egg.

Ayam Penyet is an Indonesian dish made of fried chicken that’s been gently smashed to make it extra tender. The chicken is usually marinated with garlic, turmeric, and spices, then deep-fried until crispy.  Recipe I used: 4 chicken legs or thighs (bone-in for best flavour) 4 cloves garlic 4 shallots 3 candlenuts (or substitute 6–8 cashews) 2 cm galangal 1 tsp ground coriander ½ tsp turmeric powder 1 tsp salt 1 tsp sugar 120 ml water (½ cup) - Blend the garlic, shallots, candlenuts, galangal, coriander, turmeric, salt, sugar, and water into a smooth paste. - ⁠Pour the paste into a wok with 2 tbsp of oil, place chicken into the paste, then fry on medium high heat for 5 minutes. Flipping every minute. Now add in enough water to cover the chicken and simmer for 35-40 minutes, flipping halfway. - ⁠remove the cooked chicken and strain the liquid - ⁠boil it till the volume reduces by half then season to taste with salt Batter: 150 ml of the leftover chicken cooking liquid 80 g rice flour 20 g corn flour ½ tsp baking powder - whisk all the ingredients together, then dip the chicken into this wet batter, coating it well - ⁠deep fry at 180°C or 360°F till golden brown, remember that the chicken is already cooked so you're just crisping up the crust - ⁠serve with rice and sambal/chilli paste Sambal recipe: 6–8 red chilies 5 bird’s eye chilies 3 garlic 3 shallots 1 tomato 1 tsp toasted belacan/shrimp paste 1 tsp sugar Salt + lime juice - dry fry all the ingredients except the sugar salt and lime  - ⁠pound the ingredients together into a rough paste then season with sugar salt and lime juice #ayampenyet #indonesianfood #friedchicken #chickenrecipe #friedchickenrecipe

AYAM PALEKKO Bahan 1: • 500 Gr Ayam (potong 20 bagian) • 1 SDT Desaku kunyit bubuk • 1 ½ SDT Garam • 1 SDM Air Bahan 2: (blender/haluskan) • 6 Buah Bawang Merah • 3 Buah Kemiri (goreng) • 3 Cm Jahe • 3 Cm Lengkuas • 1 SDM Desaku cabe bubuk • 1 Batang Serai (ambil 10 cm bagian putihnya saja dan rajang • 3 SDM Air Bahan 3: • 5 SDM Minyak Goreng (untuk menumis) • 3 Lembar Daun Jeruk • 2 Lembar Daun Salam Bahan 4: • 250 ml Air • 2 Kelereng Asam Jawa (rendam dengan 3 sdm air panas, ambil airnya) • 2 SDT Desaku bawang putih bubuk • ½ SDT Ladaku merica bubuk • 1 SDT Gula Cara Memasak: 1. Campurkan semua Bahan 1 ke dalam kontainer. Kocok hingga tercampur rata. Diamkan selama 30 menit. 2. Blender Bahan 2, sampai halus. 3. Panaskan 5 sendok makan Minyak, tumis bumbu yang sudah diblender (Bahan 2) sampai naik minyak. 4. Tambahkan Daun Jeruk dan Daun Salam, tumis sampai mengeluarkan aroma. 5. Masukkan ayam, tumis sampai ayam berubah warna. 6. Masukkan Bahan 4, masak sampai mendidih. 7. Kecilkan api dan masak selama 10 menit dengan wajan tertutup. 8. Lanjutkan memasak dengan wajan terbuka sampai mulai berminyak dan kekentalan kuah yang diinginkan 9. Angkat dan hidangkan. #makassar #masakanrumahan #indonesianfood

d: Hot Honey Chicken Pasta 🍯🔥 the viral recipe with over 60+ million views, 20/10 hits every time! Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. Coat chicken in seasoned flour set aside on wire rack and rest for 10 minutes before frying. Fry at 350°F until golden brown and crispy. Set aside and let cool on a wire rack. 3. In a sauce pan, add 1 tbsp of unsalted butter, buffalo sauce, honey, and hot sauce and simmer until fully combined. Then toss chicken in the hot honey sauce. 4. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. Add mozzarella and Parmesan until melted and creamy, then toss in cooked pasta. 6. Top creamy pasta with hot honey chicken and extra sauce if desired and enjoy :) #hothoneychickenpasta #hothoney #chickenpasta #pasta #fypシ

d: MEE HAILAM DAGING Mee hailam ni kena buat kat rumah baru puas makan. Susah dah nak cari kedai yang boleh buat mee hailam sedap2. Nnti yang dapat mee kicap je 😅 Untuk pot, sis guna pot legend tau. Dari sis sekolah mak sis dah guna pot jenis ni. Lebih 20 tahun dah & pot visions mak sis masih elok sampai sekarang.  Sesiapa yang mencari pot yang selamat digunakan tanpa was2, korang kena grab pot visions ni tau. Yang sis guna ni 3.25L VISIONS Covered Versa Pot dari @corellebrandsmalaysia ✨ Bahan-bahan : ✨Minyak ✨4-5 ulas bawang putih ✨1sb cili kering kisar ✨300-400g daging (hiris nipis) ✨1sk lada hitam ✨1L air ✨3sb sos tiram ✨3sb sos tomato ✨3sb sos cili ✨2sb kicap pekat ✨3sb kicap manis (boleh lebihkan ikut selera) ✨1 kiub ayam ✨Lobak merah ✨Bunga kubis ✨Sawi ✨Lada sulah ✨Air tepung jagung ✨2 biji telur ✨1 biji tomato ✨1 pack mee kuning (celur, cuci & toskan) Cara-cara : 📍Tumis bawang putih sehingga wangi. Masukkan cili kering kisar & tumis sebentar.  📍Masukkan daging & lada hitam. Masak sebentar.  📍Masukkan air, sos tiram, sos tomato, sos cili, kicap pekat, kicap manis & kiub ayam. Reneh sehingga daging empuk.  📍Masukkan sayur & serbuk lada sulah. Reneh sebentar.  📍Masukkan air tepung jagung. Kepekatan kuah ikut selera masing2.  📍Masukkan telur. Kacau perlahan.  📍Last sekali masukkan daun sawi & tomato.  📍Siap. Mudah dan pantas. Semestinya sedap 😋  Selamat mencuba 🍛 #didapuryana #meehailam #mee #meekicap #meekuning
zh: 牛肉海南炒面——这道海南炒面还是得自己在家做才过瘾，外面越来越难找到好吃的，点了有时候只得到一碗酱油面。锅具用的是Visions品牌锅，妈妈用了超过20年还好好的。食材：油、大蒜4-5瓣、干辣椒碎1汤匙、牛肉300-400g（切薄片）、黑胡椒1茶匙、水1L、蚝油3汤匙、番茄酱3汤匙、辣椒酱3汤匙、老抽2汤匙、甜酱油3汤匙、鸡精1块、胡萝卜、花椰菜、菜心、白胡椒粉、水淀粉、鸡蛋2个、番茄1个、黄面1包（焯水洗净沥干）。做法：爆香蒜末，加干辣椒碎略炒，放牛肉和黑胡椒炒匀，加水和各种酱料及鸡精煮至牛肉软烂，放蔬菜和白胡椒粉略煮，勾芡，打入鸡蛋慢慢搅散，最后放菜叶和番茄即可。简单快手，味道一定好！

d: Mac n cheese with garlic butter steak bites 🤤 RECIPE⬇️ Mac n cheese: * 12 oz pasta * Chicken bouillon (for boiling pasta) * 10 oz sharp white cheddar * 8 oz Colby Jack * 5-6 oz Mozzarella  * 2 oz Parmesan * 3 tbs butter * 3 tbs flour * 1 cup heavy cream (1.5 if you prefer saucier) * 1 12-oz can evaporated milk * 1 tsp Dijon mustard * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp paprika * Salt and pepper to taste Garlic butter steak bites: * 1 lb steak, cut into bite size cubes  * 1 tsp each: garlic powder, smoked paprika, Worcestershire * 1/2 tsp Montreal steak seasoning * 1/2 tsp dried thyme * Drizzle of oil  * Salt and pepper to taste * 1/2 stick butter * 1/4 small shallot, minced * 4-5 garlic cloves, minced * Optional: chopped parsley for garnish 1. In a bowl, mix the steak with some oil and all the seasonings. Let that marinate while you prep the mac. 2. Shred cheeses and mix together. Set aside. 3. Boil pasta in water that has been generously seasoned with chicken bouillon or salt until al dente, 1-2 min below box instructions. 4. Melt butter and bloom the spices - garlic powder, paprika - for 1 min. Then add the flour and cook for a 1-2 mins. 5. While whisking, slowly add in the heavy cream and evaporated milk. Whisk until smooth.  6. Once the mixture warms up again (but NOT simmering) turn off the heat and stir in half of your cheese mixture in batches until combined. 7. Layer in a baking dish, starting with half the mac mixture, half of the leftover cheese, the rest of the mac, and finally the rest of the cheese. Sprinkle some paprika on top for color. 8. Bake at 375F for 25-30 min until golden. Broil on low for a few min for more crust if desired. 9. While the mac is baking, add oil to a pan and sear the steak until desired doneness and it develops a nice crust. 10. 1 min before the steak is done, add 1/2 stick butter, garlic, and shallots and cook for the remaining time. 11. When mac is done baking, rest 10 min before serving and top with the steak bites. #macandcheese #steakbites #garlicbutter #creamypasta
zh: 大蒜黄油牛排配芝士通心粉食谱：通心粉部分：12盎司意面、鸡精（煮面用）、10盎司浓味白切达奶酪、8盎司科尔比杰克奶酪、5-6盎司马苏里拉奶酪、2盎司帕玛森奶酪、3汤匙黄油、3汤匙面粉、1杯浓奶油（偏稠可加1.5杯）、1罐12盎司淡奶、1茶匙第戎芥末酱、1茶匙蒜粉、1茶匙红椒粉、盐和黑胡椒适量。大蒜黄油牛排部分：1磅牛排切块、蒜粉/烟熏红椒粉/伍斯特沙司各1茶匙、蒙特利尔牛排调料半茶匙、干百里香半茶匙、少许油、盐和黑胡椒适量、半条黄油、1/4个小葱头切碎、4-5瓣大蒜切碎、可选：欧芹碎装饰。做法：1.牛排加油和所有调料腌制备用。2.将各种奶酪擦丝混合备用。3.用鸡精或盐充分调味的水煮面至八九分熟。4.融化黄油，炒香蒜粉和红椒粉约1分钟，加入面粉再炒1-2分钟。5.边搅拌边慢慢加入浓奶油和淡奶，搅至顺滑。6.混合物加热后（不要沸腾）关火，分批加入一半奶酪拌匀。7.烤盘中依次铺上一半通心粉、一半剩余奶酪、剩余通心粉、最后铺上剩余奶酪，表面撒红椒粉。8.375华氏度烤25-30分钟至金黄，如需焦脆表面可低档烤几分钟。9.通心粉烤制期间，热锅下油将牛排煎至所需熟度并形成焦壳。10.牛排出锅前1分钟加入黄油、大蒜和葱头，继续烹饪至熟。11.通心粉出炉后静置10分钟，摆上牛排块即可上桌。

d: Pull Apart Garlic Bread  Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 1 tbsp sugar * 270g milk (about 1 cup + 2 tbsp) * 380g flour (about 3 cups) * 1 tsp salt * 43g softened butter (about 3 tbsp) Butter Mixture * 100g butter, softened * 1 tbsp chopped cilantro * 1 garlic clove, minced * Shredded cheese Instructions 1. In a bowl, mix the sugar and yeast. Add the milk, then add the flour and mix until combined. 2. Add the salt and softened butter, then coil fold until the butter is fully incorporated. 3. Cover and let the dough rest for 2 hours or until doubled. 4. Mix the softened butter with the cilantro and minced garlic. 5. Roll the dough into a rectangle and spread the garlic butter mixture evenly over it. Sprinkle with shredded cheddar cheese. 6. Cut the dough in half, stack one half on top of the other, then cut into strips. Transfer the pieces into a loaf pan. 7. Cover and let rest for 20 minutes. 8. Bake at 370°F for 30 minutes, or until golden brown. 9. Brush with the remaining garlic butter mixture while still warm. #bread #garlicbread #breadtok #baking #homemadebread
zh: 手撕蒜香面包。食材：酵母1茶匙、糖1汤匙、牛奶270克、面粉380克、盐1茶匙、软化黄油43克；蒜香黄油：软化黄油100克、香菜碎1汤匙、蒜末1瓣、马苏里拉奶酪丝。做法：1.混合糖和酵母，加牛奶、面粉拌匀；2.加盐和软化黄油，折叠至完全融合；3.盖好静置2小时至膨胀一倍；4.软化黄油与香菜、蒜末混合；5.擀成长方形，涂抹蒜香黄油，撒奶酪丝；6.对半切开叠放，再切条，放入吐司模；7.盖好静置20分钟；8.以190°C烤30分钟至金黄；9.趁热刷上剩余蒜香黄油。

d: #แจกสูตรห่อหมกหมูสับ​ 🎊🎉 เมนูนี้วัตถุดิบไม่เยอะ ทำง่าย แต่รสชาติเข้มข้นจัดจ้าน ทานกับข้าวสวยร้อนๆอร่อยมากค่ะ **อัตราส่วน** หมูสับ 350 กรัม พริกแกงเผ็ด 50 กรัม น้ำตาลทราย 1 ชต. ผงปรุงรสหมู 2 ชช. น้ำปลา 1 ชต. ไข่ไก่ 2 ฟอง หัวกะทิ 140 กรัม ใบมะกรูดซอย 10 ใบ กะหล่ำปลีซอย 200 กรัม พริกแดงจินดา หรือพริกชี้ฟ้าหั่นเฉียง  ใบตอง,ไม้กลัด วิธีทำ 1.ผสมหมูบดกับเครื่องแกง+เครื่องปรุงทุกตัวยกเว้นกะหล่ำปลีซอยและใบมะกรูดซอย  ค่อยๆเทหัวกะทิลงไปนวดทีละนิดจนหมด  2.ใส่กะหล่ำปลีซอยและใบมะกรูดซอยลงไป คลุกเคล้าจนเข้ากันดี 3.ตักส่วนผสมห่อด้วยใบตอง ตกแต่งหน้าด้วยพริกชี้ฟ้าหั่นเฉียง ห่อแล้วกลัดด้วยไม้กลัดหรือไม้จิ้มฟัน แล้วนำไปนึ่งไฟกลางค่อนแรง 15-20 นาที ##ห่อหมกหมูสับ ##อาหารไทย##แม่ซีน้องมดดี้channel

d: 『鶏むね肉のパリパリねぎだれ焼き』 【材料（2〜3人分）】 ・鶏むね肉…200g ・片栗粉…大さじ5 ・水…大さじ3 ・おろしにんにく…小さじ1 ・塩…小さじ1/2 ・粗挽き黒こしょう…小さじ1/2 ・こめ油…大さじ4〜5 ・青ねぎ…適量 〈たれ〉 ・ポン酢…大さじ2 ・ごま油…小さじ1 ・白いりごま…小さじ1 ⸻ 【作り方（3工程）】 ① 下準備をする 鶏むね肉はできるだけ薄く細かく切る。 ボウルに鶏むね肉・おろしにんにく・塩・粗挽き黒こしょうを入れて混ぜる。 片栗粉と水を加え、全体がまとまるまでよく混ぜる。 ⸻ ② 焼く フライパンにこめ油を熱する。 生地を流し入れ、ヘラで押さえながら薄く広げる。 中火で4〜5分焼き、こんがり焼き色が付いたら裏返す。 反対側も4〜5分焼き、両面をカリッと焼き上げる。 ⸻ ③ 仕上げる 器に盛り付ける。 小口切りにした青ねぎを散らす。 ポン酢・ごま油・白いりごまを混ぜたたれを添えたら完成♪ ⸻ 💡【ポイント】 ・青ねぎは生地に混ぜず、仕上げに散らす＝彩りUP♪ ・鶏むね肉は薄く細かく切る＝パリパリ食感UP♪ ・厚く切るとカリカリ感が弱くなる ・おろしにんにくを加える＝香りとコクがアップ♪ ・水を大さじ3にする＝まとまりやすく焼きやすい♪ ・油を多めに使う＝揚げ焼きのようなカリカリ食感に♪ ・ヘラで軽く押さえながら焼く＝香ばしく仕上がる🤤🥢✨ 🍻 外はカリッと、中はジューシー♪ ポン酢だれがよく合う、ごはんもお酒も進む一品です♪ Crispy Chicken Breast with Green Onion Ponzu Sauce Ingredients (2–3 servings) ・Chicken Breast…200g ・Potato Starch…5 tbsp ・Water…3 tbsp ・Grated Garlic…1 tsp ・Salt…1/2 tsp ・Black Pepper…1/2 tsp ・Rice Oil…4–5 tbsp ・Green Onion…to taste 〈Sauce〉 ・Ponzu Sauce…2 tbsp ・Sesame Oil…1 tsp ・White Sesame Seeds…1 tsp ⸻ Instructions (3 Steps) ① Prepare Finely chop the chicken breast into small pieces. Place the chicken breast, grated garlic, salt, and black pepper in a bowl and mix well. Add the potato starch and water, then mix until evenly combined. ⸻ ② Cook Heat the rice oil in a frying pan. Spread the mixture into a thin, round layer, pressing it gently with a spatula. Cook over medium heat for 4–5 minutes until golden brown. Flip and cook the other side for another 4–5 minutes until crispy. ⸻ ③ Finish Transfer to a serving plate. Sprinkle with chopped green onion. Mix the ponzu sauce, sesame oil, and white sesame seeds, then serve alongside or drizzle over the top. ⸻ Tips ・Add the green onion at the end for better color and freshness. ・Finely chopping the chicken breast creates an extra crispy texture. ・Larger pieces will be less crispy. ・Grated garlic adds depth and flavor. ・Using 3 tbsp of water helps the mixture hold together. ・A generous amount of oil creates a crispy, pan-fried texture. ・Press gently with a spatula while cooking for an even golden crust. 🤤🥢✨ 🍻 Crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside♪ The refreshing ponzu sauce pairs perfectly with this easy chicken dish. Great with rice or your favorite drink! #料理 #cooking #japanesefood #鶏胸肉 #ChickenBreast

d: The easiest Korean meal I make for guests Samgyeopsal Kimchi Jjim (삼겹살 김치찜) 🧡 Ingredients  500 g (1.1 lb) aged kimchi 1 kg (2.2 lb) pork belly 💙 Directions  1. Add the kimchi and pork belly to a pot. Pour in enough water to just cover the ingredients. 2. Bring to a boil, then reduce to medium heat and simmer for 40–60 minutes. 💡 Tips - Don't use fresh kimchi! This dish only works with well-fermented (aged) kimchi. If you're buying kimchi from the store, look for "aged" or "fermented" on the label. If you can only find regular kimchi, let it ferment at room temperature for about 2 days or in the refrigerator for about 5 days before using it. - If your kimchi is too sour, add 1 tbsp sugar. If it's not sour enough, add 1 tbsp vinegar. - You can use any cut of pork, but fattier cuts work best because the rendered fat adds richness to the broth and kimchi. I recommend pork belly or pork shoulder. - I also added 1 tbsp plum syrup and ½ tbsp doenjang (Korean soybean paste). These are completely optional, but they help reduce any pork odor and add extra umami. Since kimchi is already seasoned with garlic, chili peppers, and other aromatics, you don't need any additional seasoning to make this dish delicious. 🔖 Save this recipe for your next meal  🥰 Like, follow & comment if you enjoyed  .  .  . .  . . #k#koreanfoode#easyrecipesc#comfortfoodkimchi #samgyupsal

d: This spicy vegan “tuna” with crunchy cucumber and rice is such a good combo😋🫶🏻🥒🍚 Spicy “tuna” cucumber sushi Ingredients: For the cucumber base: • 2 large cucumbers • about 1½ cups cooked sushi rice For the “tuna” filling: • 1 can (430 g) chickpeas, drained and rinsed • 1 pickle, finely chopped • 1 celery stalk, very finely chopped • 2 tbsp onion, very finely chopped • 1 nori sheet, finely chopped • 1 tbsp mustard • 2 tbsp vegan mayo • Salt to taste Toppings: • 1 jalapeño, sliced • Teriyaki sauce • Spicy sauce • Sesame seeds • Green onion, chopped For serving: • Soy sauce How to make: 1. Cut the cucumbers in half lengthwise and scoop out the seeds with a spoon to create boats. 2. Fill each cucumber half with sushi rice, pressing gently so it holds its shape. 3. In a bowl, mash the chickpeas with a fork until flaky. 4. Add the pickle, celery, onion, nori, mustard, vegan mayo, and salt. Mix well. 5. Spoon the chickpea “tuna” mixture over the rice. 6. Top with sliced jalapeño. 7. Drizzle with teriyaki sauce and spicy sauce. 8. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and green onion. 9. Slice into sushi pieces and serve with soy sauce. #vegansushi #cucumbersushi #quicksushi #spicytuna #veganrecipes

d: This might be the only soup I will never get tired of eating 🥰 Beef Sinigang is so comforting and delicious!  Ingredients 2 packets @knorr tamarind soup mix 1 lb beef brisket 3 beef spare ribs Fish sauce to taste 3 tomatoes 1 large onion 2 taro root Handful of okra 1 eggplant 6 bundles bok choy Handful of green beans 3 Thai chili Salt & pepper to taste Instructions Season the brisket with salt, pepper, and fish sauce. Sear with 1 tomato, 1/2 onion, and taro until browned. Cover with water and pressure cook for 45 minutes. Add remaining veggies + tamarind soup mix. Boil until veggies are tender (not mushy). Serve with rice and enjoy. #sinigang #beefsinigang #soursoup #filipinofood #pinoyfood

d: 🇵🇭 Beef Salpicao | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 12 My take on a delicious FIlipino-Spanish dish usually made with tender beef cubes cooked in garlic, butter and Worcestershire sauce — but with extra garlic flavor!  * this recipe is only a guideline. most ingredients are just estimates so taste and adjust with your ❤️ INGREDIENTS: Beef salpicao: - 500g ribeye steak (or any cut of steak of your choice) - 300g of button mushrooms - Salt and pepper to taste - Oil for frying - 1/4 block of butter - 15-20 cloves of garlic, minced - 3 tbsp of Worcestershire sauce  - 1  tbsp of oyster sauce  - 2 tbsp of paprika  Garlic confit: - 300g of peeled garlic cloves - Olive Oil to cover Garnish: - parsley - crunchy garlic - pickled peppers INSTRUCTIONS: - Start by seasoning your steak and grilling until medium rare. Slice them into bite sized chunks and set aside for later - Slice button mushrooms. In a pan , add oil and/or butter, sauté the button mushrooms until they get deeper in color. Season with salt and pepper.  - Add minced garlic to a hot pan with oil and butter, and saute unti fragrant. Add back your steak and mushroom and add Worcestershire sauce, oyster sauce, paprika and black pepper. - To make it extra garlicky, we’re adding some garlic confit. To make it, simply add peeled garlic to a pot, cover with oil, and cook low and slow until the cloves are soft and golden. - Serve with garlic rice and enjoy! #CookingASMR #ASMR # FilipinoFood #pinoyfood
zh: 菲律宾菜圣经第12集：牛肉Salpicao——蒜香黄油伍斯特酱炒牛肉（附详细食谱）

d: Growing up I never even thought to try laing because of the way it looked. But as an adult I finally gave it a shot and holy sh*t it's so good. Easily one of the most underrated dishes in the Filipino kitchen. The secret is fresh coconut milk I made mine from scratch (full how-to in my last post, made it specifically for this). And one rule: once the taro leaves go in, don't touch them. Let them sink and drink up the coconut milk so they cook all the way through. Please see recipe below: 1/2 lb pork belly, diced 1 Onion, sliced 3Tbs minced Garlic 3Tbs minced Ginger 1tsp black peppercorns 1/3C bagoong (shrimp paste) 3.5oz dried taro leaves 6C fresh coconut milk (first cook, to get the leaves tender) 2C fresh coconut milk (added after leaves are tender + can mix) 2 long green chilies 3–4 fresh red Thai chilies (more if you like it spicy) Fish sauce, to taste Best served with warm rice. Even better the next day.
zh: 小时候我从没想过要尝试laing，因为它的卖相。但长大后我终于试了一次，天哪，真的太好吃了。绝对是菲律宾菜里最被低估的菜肴之一。秘诀是新鲜椰奶，我从头自制（详细做法在上一篇帖子里）。还有一条铁律：芋头叶放进去之后，不要动它，让它慢慢沉下去吸饱椰奶，彻底煮透。食谱如下：猪五花半磅切丁、洋葱1个切片、蒜末3大勺、姜末3大勺、黑胡椒粒1茶匙、虾酱1/3杯、干芋头叶3.5盎司、新鲜椰奶6杯（第一次下锅让叶子变软）、新鲜椰奶2杯（叶子变软后加入）、长青辣椒2根、新鲜红色泰国辣椒3-4根（喜欢辣可以多放）、鱼露适量。搭配热米饭食用，隔天吃更香。

d: Sinigang is a classic Filipino dish that every Pinoy loves! Mama probably has made this dish once a week for more than 40 years since we were little and it’s delicious every time! It’s sour, tangy, and comforting. You can make it with any meat, but pork is always a Pinoy’s first choice! 🤎
zh: Sinigang是每个菲律宾人都爱的经典菜肴！妈妈从我们小时候起每周至少做一次，做了四十多年，每次都好吃！它酸爽开胃又暖心。可以用任何肉来做，但猪肉永远是菲律宾人的首选！

d: How to make Pork Binagoongan. A Filipino pork dish that's unique and delicious. BAGOONG or fermented shrimp paste is the star ingredient in this dish. It has a bold, funky aroma that doesn't exactly whisper "eat me" but don't let the smell fool you. Much like blue cheese, anchovies or well-aged French cheese, some of the world's most beloved foods are a little intimidating before they become irresistible. The bagoong transforms the tender and soft pork into a rich, umami-packed dish that's salty and savory. Grabe sarap especially with steamed white rice, duh! 🍚 🤤 I'm using @Barrio Fiesta Foods  Bagoong Hipon that you can buy at your local Asian supermarkets  FULL RECIPE is on my site www.TitaBecky.com Search "PORK BINAGOONGAN" in the search bar #filipinofood #filipinorecipe #bagoong #foodtok #filipino
zh: 猪肉Binagoongan的做法。这是一道独特又美味的菲律宾猪肉料理，虾酱是这道菜的灵魂食材。它气味浓烈刺激，不会让你第一眼就想吃，但别被味道吓到。就像蓝纹奶酪、凤尾鱼或陈年法国奶酪一样，世界上最令人上瘾的食物往往在你爱上它之前都有点吓人。虾酱把软嫩的猪肉变成了一道鲜香浓郁、咸香十足的料理。配白米饭简直绝了！我用的是Barrio Fiesta Foods虾酱，可以在当地亚洲超市买到。完整食谱请访问www.TitaBecky.com，搜索"PORK BINAGOONGAN"

🇵🇭 Kare Kare | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 10 Kare-kare is a rich Filipino stew made with oxtail, tripe, and vegetables, all simmered in a thick peanut sauce. It’s usually served with bagoong (fermented shrimp paste) on the side to balance the flavors and an extra level of umami and saltiness 😋 INGREDIENTS: Boiling liquid: - 1-2 red onions, chopped - 2 bulbs of garlic, chopped - 1 tbsp of salt - 1 tbsp peppercorns - 5-6 bay leaves - 1 kg of oxtail - 650g of ox tripe - Beef stock as needed Kare Kare: - 10g of annatto powder - 2 tablespoons oil - 15-20 cloves garlic, minced - 2 tbsp annatto powder - 1 white onion, diced - 1 banana heart, chopped, washed and rinsed w/ salt - Beef stock as needed - green beans, chopped - eggplants, quartered - pechay/bok choy - 1 ½ cup peanut butter - Patis to taste - ½ teaspoon salt - 1 tbsp of sugar (optional to taste) Toasted rice slurry: - 1:5 tbsp of water to toasted rice, blended Served with:  - Bagoong  - Crushed peanuts INSTRUCTIONS:  - Start by seasoning your meat with salt and pepper and sear. Add all ingredients under “boiling liquid” and fill the pot as needed with beef stock. Simmer until tender, remove meat and set aside the broth for later.  - Saute onions, garlic, and banana hearts in oil mixed with annatto powder. Add your meat back and cover with the broth from the boiling liquid and simmer for 15-20 minutes. - To thicken the mixture, add toasted rice to a food processor or blender. Take some of the rice and mix with water to form our slurry.  - Add both rice slurry and peanut butter stir and reduce to thicken. Season with patis/salt/pepper and add your vegetables.  - Serve alongside bagoong top and enjoy!  #CookingASMR #ASMR #FilipinoFood #PinoyFood

🇵🇭 Adobo Flakes w/ Pako Kimchi 🇰🇷Collab w/ @Kevin  Here’s my take on the best way to have your leftover adobo by making it into yummy crunchy strands. Usually we have it w/ Vinegar or a sort of pickle. We have a special guest today so we decided to pair it with a  quick kimchi made with an indigenous edible fern called “Pako” known for its addicting crisp texture! Also using my take on a pre-colonial Adobo Recipe called “Adobo sa Puti” that doesn’t use soy sauce so it retains a golden color when toasted :) *we kinda measured by feel so these measurements are just estimates. taste and season as you go! INGREDIENTS: Adobo: - Banana leaves - Pork lard as needed - 1 kg of pork shoulder, cubed - 5-10 bay leaves - 1 tbsp of peppercorns - Salt to taste  - 20-30 cloves of garlic, or to your hearts desire - 5-6 of long green chilies - ¼ cup of fish sauce - ⅔ cup of coconut vinegar (or white vinegar)  - Water as needed Pako:  - 500g of pako or fiddlehead fern, chopped - Salt - Hot water - Ice  Kimchi blend: - 1/2 cup garlic - 1 onion, chopped - 1-2 mangoes, chopped - 1 cup cooked rice - ¼ cup sugar - 1-2 tbsp fish sauce - Water as needed - Gochugaru as needed - 1 bunch garlic chives Others: - Fried egg - Garlic rice INSTRUCTIONS:  - For the adobo, add all the ingredients under “Adobo sa Puti” into a pot. cook for 1–2 hours on low, or until the pork is tender. shred into flakes - Fry the shreds on low heat w/ a little oil/lard until crispy and golden. - For the pako , add salt and pour over hot water. immediately shock it in ice water. - For the kimchi base, blend all ingredients under “Kimchi Blend,” except for the gochugaru and chives. Transfer to a bowl, mix in gochugaru, chives and pako and toss until well coated. - Serve with garlic rice, fried egg and enjoy! #cookingasmr #asmr #filipinofood

🇵🇭 Pork Binagoongan | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 11 One of the more underrated but S tier Filipino dishes!! Usually made with pork simmered in “bagoong alamang”, or fermented shrimp paste - best served with rice, sometimes with eggplant or green mango on the side. Its savory, funky, and slightly sweet, with tons of umami 💡Pro tip: adjust depending on your bagoong. Not all bagoong tastes the same — some are saltier, milder, or sweeter — so taste as you go and balance it out with sugar, vinegar, and tomatoes. INGREDIENTS: Binagoongan: - 1.5 kg pork ribs, blanched (you can use pork belly or cut of choice) - 5-6 tbsp bagoong guisado - 1 large onion, diced - 15-20 cloves garlic, sliced - 4 long green chilies, sliced - 350g tomatoes, sliced - 1/3 cup cane vinegar - 1/3 cup brown sugar - 1/4 cup soy sauce - Water as needed - Black pepper, to taste Bagoong Guisado: - 400g shrimp paste (alamang) - 25-30 cloves garlic - 7-10 red chilies - 6-7 shallots - 400g tomatoes, diced - 1/4 cup vinegar - 1/3 cup brown sugar Ensaladang Mangga: - Green mango - Red onion - Cilantro - Tomato - Lime - Salt - Pepper INSTRUCTIONS:  - Blanch pork for 10 minutes, before straining and rinsing. Set aside. - To make the bagoong start by blitzing onions or shallots, garlic, and red chilies in a processor.  Add to cold pan with oil and cook until garlic is slightly oasted add tomatoes, alamang, sugar and vinegar. Allow this to simmer until the oil comes out and the tomatoes are jammy. - For the binagoongan start by sauteing onions, garlic, and chilies. add back your meat and all other ingredients listed under  “Binagoongan” and simmer for 40mins-1hr or until tender - In the meantime you can pair this with a fresh ensalada by combining all ingredients under “ensalada”. - Serve and enjoy! #CookingASMR #ASMR #FilipinoFood #pinoyfood

🇵🇭 Chicken Tinola (Tinolang Manok) | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 9  Tinola a humble yet comforting chicken soup dish dates back to the pre-colonial Philippines. For my version I also used Native chicken for its added flavor along with cubes of chicken blood which is used by some households when preparing this dish INGREDIENTS: Chicken Tinola - 1 onion, sliced - 10-15 cloves of garlic, sliced - 80-100g of ginger, sliced - 1 native chicken, portioned (you can also use regular whole chicken) - 1 stalk of lemongrass - 400-500g of green papaya, cut into wedges - 6-8 pcs of green chilies - 3-5 tbsp of patis - 1-2 cups of chili leaves - 2 cups of moringa/malunggay leaves  - Chicken stock as needed - Salt and pepper to taste Chicken blood: - 1 block of chicken blood - A pinch of salt - Pepper to taste - Oil INSTRUCTIONS - Start by sauteing onions, garlic and ginger in a pot until softened. Add your sliced chicken. - Add in your lemongrass stalk, patis, and salt and pepper and cover and allow to simmer for 40mins - 1hr 30mins (depending on what chicken you use) until soft. -  add in the rest of your vegetables and simmer for 15 mins. Add in the leaves at the very last min and allow residual heat to cook them. set aside. - Add your block of chicken blood along with some salt, and boil for 10-15 minutes. Remove and slice into cubes. - Shallow fry cubes for 3-5 mins - Serve the tinola w your chicken blood and enjoy! #cookingasmr #asmr #filipinofood #pinoyfood

PABORITO MO RIN BA ANG SINIGANG? Alam mo ba na isa ito sa mga pinakamatanda at pinaka-iconic na Filipino dishes? Wala mang exact na origin, widely believed na nagmula ito sa Pilipinas before the Spanish colonization, kung kailan gumagamit na ang ating mga ninuno ng sampalok bilang natural na pampaasim. Today, marami na itong versions like sinigang na baboy, hipon, baka, at isda. Kaya hindi nakakapagtaka kung bakit isa pa rin ito sa mga paboritong comfort foods ng mga Pilipino, lalo na kapag maulan. Fun Fact: Kapag Sinigang na Hipon ang niluluto, huwag alisin ang ulo at shell ng hipon. Doon kasi nanggagaling ang natural oils at rich shrimp flavor na nagpapasarap sa sabaw. At eto pa—kapag ang hipon ay naka-curve na parang letter “C”, perfectly cooked na ‘yan. Kapag naging “O”, overcooked na ito at makunat.  #Sinigang #Homecooking #lutongbahay #FilipinoFood #easyrecipe

d: Here is my One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta Dinner 🤤🍝 full recipe on my website.  Crispy on the outside, juicy and full of flavor chicken over a rich, creamy, cheesy pasta. Easy comfort food made in one pot! No mess no stress dinner 😊 One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta:  Ingredients Chicken 2 chicken breasts 1 tbsp olive oil 1–2 tbsp butter 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder Salt and black pepper, to taste Pasta & Sauce 8 oz dry rigatoni 24 oz heavy cream 24 oz chicken broth (add more if needed) 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1–2 cups shredded cheese of your choice (I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar) Optional Garnish Fresh parsley, chopped Grated Parmesan cheese Red pepper flakes Instructions Season the chicken: Coat the chicken breasts with olive oil, Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, sweet paprika, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Let the chicken marinate in the refrigerator for 15–30 minutes for the best flavor. Cook the chicken: Heat a large pot or skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for about 2–3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove the chicken from the pan and let it rest. Cook the pasta: In the same pot, add the rigatoni, heavy cream, chicken broth, 1–2 tbsp butter, and seasonings. Stir everything together, cover, and let the pasta simmer until al dente, stirring occasionally. Add more broth or cream if needed while the pasta cooks. Add the cheese: Once the pasta is cooked, add your shredded cheese and stir until melted and creamy. I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar, but feel free to use whatever cheese you have in the fridge. Finish and serve: Slice the rested chicken and place it on top of the creamy pasta. Garnish with fresh parsley, Parmesan cheese, or red pepper flakes if desired. #easyrecipe  #pasta #chicken #familydinner #onepot

Braised Chicken Legs with Rice, Potatoes & Veggies🍗 Ingredients * 1 package chicken drumsticks (6–7 pieces) * 1-2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp salt * 1 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp garlic powder * 2 tsp onion powder * 2 tsp paprika * ½ tsp cumin * 1 jalapeño, diced * ½ red onion, diced * 1 tbsp sun-dried tomato paste * 1 tbsp @Loisa sofrito * 5–6 garlic cloves, minced * 4 cups chicken stock * 1 (8 oz) can tomato sauce * Small potatoes, halved (about 10–12 baby potatoes) * 1 zucchini, diced * Cooked white rice, for serving (let me know if you guys want my rice recipe) Instructions: 1. Clean the chicken with vinegar, then pat completely dry with paper towels. 2. Season the chicken with the salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and cumin. Toss until evenly coated. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven or deep skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Brown the chicken for 2–3 minutes per side until golden. It doesn’t need to be cooked through. Remove and set aside. 5. In the same pot, add the diced jalapeño and red onion. Cook for about 5 minutes until softened. 6. Stir in the sun-dried tomato paste and cook for 30 seconds. 7. Add the Loisa Sofrito and minced garlic. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant. 8. Pour in the chicken stock and tomato sauce, stirring to combine. Bring to a gentle boil. 9. Return the chicken to the pot. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 1 hour, or until the chicken is fall-apart tender and the sauce has reduced. 10. About 20 minutes before the chicken is done, add the halved potatoes and diced zucchini. Continue simmering until the potatoes are fork-tender and the zucchini is cooked. 11. Serve over fluffy white rice and spoon plenty of the sauce over the top. #chickenlegs #braised #onepotmeals #cookwithme

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🌶️ Why did no one tell me adding cream to pasta makes it taste 100x better? But why does it have to be a million calories for it to taste this good?🥲 Ingredients 300g pasta 1kg chicken 200ml double cream 50g butter 2 onions (finely chopped) 4 garlic cloves (diced) Fresh or dried parsley Parmesan (depends how big your back is🤓) Mozzarella (depends how big your back is🤓) Cajun Seasoning 2 tbsp paprika 1 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tbsp garlic powder 1 tbsp thyme 1 tsp cayenne pepper 1½ tsp onion powder 1 tsp oregano Oil Juice of ½ lemon salt Or just buy a store-bought Cajun seasoning if you can’t be bothered🙂 Method👇 1️⃣ Add all the Cajun seasoning, oil and lemon juice to the chicken and marinate for at least 1 hour. 2️⃣ Heat a little oil in a pan and sear the chicken on both sides until fully cooked. Remove the chicken and DON’T throw away the oil in the pan❌ That’s where all the flavour is. 3️⃣ Add the butter to the same pan, then add the onions. Sauté until they’ve softened and reduced in size (around 5 minutes depending on how finely they’re chopped). 4️⃣ Add the garlic and cook for 1–2 minutes until fragrant. 5️⃣ Pour in a splash of water to stop the garlic frying, then add the double cream and stir everything together. Add another sprinkle of Cajun seasoning to the sauce. 6️⃣ Add your al dente pasta and toss until every piece is coated in that creamy sauce. 7️⃣ Add as much Parmesan and mozzarella as your heart desires. Finish with parsley, then sprinkle over some chilli flakes if you like a bit of heat🥵 #fyp #creamy #cajunpasta

Steak & Eggs, cooked entirely in a cast iron pan on my balcony. There’s something about a hot cast iron, a ribeye, crispy potatoes, and eggs that just feels right. Ingredients: * 1 ribeye steak * Salt & black pepper * 3 Yukon Gold potatoes, cut into large chunks * 1 onion, julienned * 3 eggs * 1 tbsp neutral oil Cowboy Butter: * 1 stick (½ cup) butter, melted * 2 cloves garlic, minced * 2 tbsp chopped parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes * ½ tsp Cajun seasoning * ½ tsp cayenne pepper * Salt & black pepper, to taste Method: 1. Preheat a cast iron pan in a 500°F pizza oven (or any very hot oven). Add the neutral oil and sear the ribeye until medium-rare to medium. Remove and let it rest. 2. Add the onion and cook until deeply golden. Stir in the potatoes and roast until they’re tender with crispy edges. 3. Push the potatoes to the outside of the pan, leaving a circle in the center. Crack in the 3 eggs. 4. Slice the rested steak. Pour in the cowboy butter, add the steak back to the pan, and let everything sizzle until the eggs are cooked to your liking. 5. Serve immediately and spoon that cowboy butter over everything. #steakandeggs #easyrecipes #ribeye #torontofood

d: Lemon garlic salmon pasta ✨🍋 Ingredients  Salmon - 4 salmon fillets - 1 tsp kinder’s lemon garlic butter seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic powder  - 1 tsp paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - Salt and pepper to taste - 1 tbsp butter - 1 tbsp avocado oil  - 14 oz fettuccine  Cream sauce - 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream - 1/4 cup lemon juice - 1/4 cup pasta water - 1 lemon, zested - 3 tbsp butter  - 6 garlic cloves, minced - 2 shallot, finely chopped  - 1 cup Parmesan cheese  - 1 heaping tsp garlic powder  - 1 heaping tsp kinders lemon garlic butter sesoning - 1 tsp basil - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 - 1/2 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions - Bring a large pot of well-salted water to a boil. - Cook fettuccine according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain and set aside. - Pat salmon filets dry. - Rub with avocado oil, then season with paprika, garlic powder, oregano, kinders lemon garlic butter seasoning, salt, and pepper. - Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and butter. Sear salmon for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through, basting with the pan drippings. Remove and set aside. - In the same skillet, reduce heat to medium. Add butter and let melt. Sauté shallot for about 3 minutes until softened, then add garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant. - Stir in lemon juice and heavy cream. Let simmer for 2–3 minutes until slightly thickened, then add lemon zest. - Add seasonings and freshly grated Parmesan. Stir until smooth. Pour in reserved pasta water and mix until the sauce is well combined. Taste and adjust salt and pepper as needed. - Add cooked pasta to the skillet and toss until evenly coated in the sauce. - Garnish with fresh parsley and serve alongside the salmon. • • • #Recipe #DinnerIdeas #pasta #salmonrecipe #recipeideas

d: Cowboy butter steak bites ✨ My husband ate both of these plates and rated it a 10/10 😭 Ingredients  Steak - 2 pounds ribeye or sirloin steak, cubed - 1 tbsp neutral oil - 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - Salt and pepper to taste (generous amount) “Caramelized” onions  - 1 large yellow onion, sliced - 1 tsp granulated sugar  - Heaping pinch of salt Cowboy butter - 12 tbsp unsalted butter - 5 garlic cloves, minced  - 1 shallot, minced  - 1 lemon, freshly squeezed - 1 tbsp Dijon mustard  - 1 heaping tbsp parsley, chopped - 1 heaping tbsp chives, chopped - 1 tsp thyme - 1 tsp cayenne powder (adjust to heat preference  - 1/2 tsp red chili flakes - 1/2 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste  Instructions  - Toss cubed steak with oil, Worcestershire, garlic powder, and a generous amount of salt & pepper. Set aside while the pan heats. - Heat a skillet over medium heat with a little oil or butter. - Add onions, sugar, and salt. Cook 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft, golden, and jammy. Remove from pan and set aside. - Crank heat to medium-high/high. Add steak in a single layer (work in batches if needed). - Sear 2–3 minutes per side until deeply browned. Remove and set aside. Lower heat to medium. - Add butter to the same pan. Once melted, add garlic and shallot — cook ~30 seconds until fragrant. - Stir in lemon juice, Dijon, parsley, chives, thyme, cayenne, chili flakes, smoked paprika, and salt. - Add steak back to the pan. - Toss to coat in the butter sauce for 1–2 minutes. - Serve over creamy mashed potatoes and enjoy! • • • #recipe #steak #dinnerideas #food #steak

d: Hot honey chicken sliders 🍔✨🍯 Ingredients  Chicken  - 1lb chicken breast, cut in half to create smaller pieces  - 1 1/3 cups buttermilk  - 1/4 cup hot sauce - 1/4 cup pickle juice  - 1 1/2 cup all purpose flour  - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp onion powder  - 2 tsp cayenne powder (use less if desired) - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp mustard powder  - 1 tsp salt - 1/2 tsp black pepper  - 1/2 tsp msg (optional) - Oil for frying  - Slider buns Hot honey sauce - 2 tbsp unsalted butter  - 1/3 cup hot sauce  - 1/2 cup honey - 1/2 tsp brown sugar  - 1/8 tsp salt  Instructions: - In a bowl, combine chicken pieces, buttermilk, seasonings, pickle juice and hot sauce. Let sit for 3 hours (or overnight in the fridge for best results). - In another bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, mustard powder, cayenne, salt, and pepper. - Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). - Remove chicken from marinade, letting excess drip off. Dredge in seasoned flour mixture, pressing to coat well. Rest the floured chicken for 10 minutes before frying  - Fry in batches 4–6 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Drain on a wire rack or paper towels.  - In a small saucepan combine honey, butter, and hot sauce. Mix until well combined. Let it simmer for 3-4 minutes then remove from heat - Brush chicken with hot honey sauce on both sides - Slice buns horizontally and brush with butter, place into a pan on medium high heat and toast until slightly golden brown.  - Mix melted butter, parsley and garlic powder. Brush over buns. • • • #hothoneychicken #friedchicken #DinnerIdeas #Recipe #hothoney #cooking

d: Let me fatten you up with comfort in liquid form. Pozole Rojo is semi Debatably one of the best soups ever. #soup #mexicanfood  here is the recipe do you aren't wandering for it  [For soup] 4qt water 2lbs pork shoulder 1lbs baby back ribs 1/2 Onion cut into quarters 12 cloves of garlic 2 bay leaves Salt and pepper to taste 2 cans white hominy  [FOR RED SAUCE] 5 guajillo chiles  5 ancho chiles garlic from the soup 1/2 large white onion 1tsp dried Mexican oregano 2Tbsp oil (to cook it) 1/2msg salt and pepper to taste. 1.simmer pork shoulder, ribs, garlic, onion, and bay leaves for two hours. (skim foam) 2. remove meat from soup and shred then add back to pot (trim fat as needed) 3. soak dried ancho and guajilla peppers 30 minutes before soup is done simmering (until soft) 4.add softened peppers to blender along with, garlic from soup, onion from soup, fresh onion, oregano, salt, pepper, msg, and 1/4c broth and blend.  5. Cook sauce with hot oil in pan until thickened. (20 minutes on low after boil) 6.add red sauce to soup and cook for 5 minutes. add hominy and cook until heated through.  7. serve your huge back self (like me) a big ole bowl.

d: Sheet Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken and Potatoes 🧄🧈 For ALL of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store 🫶 Minimal effort, maximum flavor… juicy chicken, crispy potatoes covered in garlicky parmesan butter perfection 🔥 For the potatoes: - 1.5 lbs (680 g) baby potatoes - 1/3 cup butter, melted - 1 cup parmesan cheese - 8 garlic cloves, minced - Seasonings: 2 tsp each of paprika, oregano, garlic powder, salt, black pepper - 3 tbsp olive oil For the chicken: - 6 to 8 chicken thighs, boneless & skinless - Seasonings: 1 tbsp seasoning salt, 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp italian seasoning, 1 tsp cumin - 1 lemon, juiced - 2 tbsp mayonnaise For the garlic & onion: - 2 garlic heads + 2 tbsp olive oil + 2 tsp salt - 1 red onion, cut into chunks + olive oil, drizzled For the Aioli:  - 1/3 cup greek yogurt + 1/3 cup mayonnaise - 2 roasted garlic heads - 1/4 lemon, juiced - 2 tsp black pepper + 1 tsp salt - 3 tbsp chives, chopped For the Baste (optional ): - 1/4 cup mayonnaise  - 1/4 cup parmesan  - 2 tsp paprika Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken, seasonings, lemon juice, garlic, and mayonnaise. Mix well and marinate for as long as you wish (up to overnight). 2. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Add the potatoes to a large casserole dish. Toss with the melted butter, parmesan, olive oil, garlic, and seasonings. Spread evenly. 3. Top with the chicken thighs. Add the red onion chunks around the dish & drizzle them with olive oil.  4. Slice the tops off the garlic heads, drizzle with olive oil and salt, wrap in foil, & place in dish. 5. Bake for 40 mins. Broil for the last 2–3 mins if desired.  6. Optional but recommended: Mix together mayo, parmesan, and paprika. At the 20-min mark, baste the chicken & return to the oven. 7. In a bowl, combine the yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and chives. Squeeze in as much of the roasted garlic as you wish OR chop them up first. Mix. 8. Finish with fresh parm, chives, & lemon slices. Enjoy! #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv #dinner #recipesoftiktok #dinnerideas

d: This is my new favourite high-protein comfort meal 🤤 Think chukauni… but with juicy golden chicken, smoky mustard oil tadka, garlic-y curd, and those Nepali-style flavours that just hit different. It’s rich, tangy, spicy, creamy — and honestly perfect with soft rotis or steaming hot rice. Nepali Style Chicken Chukauni 🥣 Serves: 3 🔥 Macros (per serving): Calories: 374 kcal | Protein: 38 g | Carbs: 2.7 g | Fat: 22.3 g Ingredients For the Chicken • 400 g boneless chicken thigh (or breast), cut into small cubes • 2 tsp ginger-garlic paste • ½ tsp salt • ½ tsp pepper • 1 tsp Kashmiri chili powder • ½ tsp turmeric powder • 1 tsp lemon juice • Light brush or spray of oil for frying For the Mix • 1 small onion, thinly sliced • 1–2 green chilies, chopped • 3 tbsp fresh coriander leaves, chopped (divided) For the Yogurt Base • 1 cup thick curd (I used Amul High-Protein Curd) or Greek yogurt • 1 tsp garlic paste • ½ tsp salt • ½ tsp sugar For the Tadka • 1.5 tbsp mustard oil • ½ tsp turmeric powder • 1 tsp Kashmiri chili powder • 1 tsp kasuri methi (dried fenugreek leaves), crushed Method 1️⃣ Mix chicken with ginger-garlic paste, salt, pepper, Kashmiri chili powder, turmeric, and lemon juice. Rest 10–15 minutes. 2️⃣ Brush or spray a pan with very little oil. Pan-fry chicken on medium-high until golden brown. Transfer to a bowl. 3️⃣ Add sliced onion, chopped chilies, and half the coriander. Mix well and set aside. 4️⃣ In another bowl, whisk thick curd with garlic paste, salt, and sugar until smooth and creamy. 5️⃣ Heat mustard oil until smoking hot. Turn off the heat, add turmeric, Kashmiri chili powder, and crushed kasuri methi. 6️⃣ Pour the hot tadka into the curd and swirl gently to keep the streaks. 7️⃣ Pour the yogurt mixture over the chicken mixture. Mix gently. Finish with more chopped coriander leaves. Enjoy with soft rotis or steaming hot rice. . (chicken chukauni, Nepali chicken recipe, high protein Indian recipes, yogurt chicken salad, chicken curry, easy dinner, healthy chicken dinner, chukauni recipe) . #HealthyRecipes #NepaliFood #IndianCooking #ComfortFood #EasyDinners

d: 📌 SAVE THIS RECIPE FOR LATER A restaurant would charge you $40 or more for a plate like this, but today we’re making it right at home. 🔥🦀🐟 This Lemon Garlic Butter Crab Stuffed Salmon is packed with lump crab meat, seasoned to perfection, and finished with a buttery lemon garlic sauce that’ll have you going back for seconds. 🦀 Crab Stuffing • 8 oz lump crab meat • ¼ cup mayo • 1 egg • ¼ cup crushed Ritz crackers • 1 tbsp Dijon mustard • 1 tsp Garlic & Herb Old Bay • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tbsp fresh parsley • Pinch of salt • 1 tsp lemon zest • Splash of lemon juice Mix gently. Don’t overwork the crab. Add a little extra Ritz cracker if needed until the mixture is thick but not dry. 🐟 Salmon Seasoning • Garlic powder • Onion powder • Paprika • Lemon pepper • Black pepper • Light Cajun seasoning Pat salmon dry, cut a pocket into the side, season generously, and stuff with the crab mixture. 🧈 Lemon Garlic Butter Sauce • 1 stick butter • 1 tbsp minced garlic • Juice of 1 lemon • 1 tsp Old Bay • 1 tsp parsley Cook low and slow until combined. 🔥 Cooking Instructions Sear salmon in a hot cast iron skillet over medium heat for 2–3 minutes per side. Transfer to a 400°F oven. Bake for 18–22 minutes. During the last few minutes, spoon lemon garlic butter over the top. Broil lightly if desired. 🍚 Lemon Herb Rice • Butter • Garlic • Chicken broth • Lemon zest • Fresh parsley 🌱 Roasted Garlic Lemon Asparagus • 1 bunch asparagus • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 tbsp melted butter • 1 tsp garlic • Salt • Black pepper • Lemon zest Roast at 425°F for 10–12 minutes. Finish with fresh lemon juice. If you make this recipe, tag me so I can see it! ❤️ #CookUpKi #CrabStuffedSalmon #SalmonRecipe #EasyDinnerIdeas #SeafoodRecipe

d: Fiesta Table Style #salsa #spicy #mexicanfood  INGREDIENTS: • 3 tomatillos • 9 small Roma tomatoes (or 7–8 large) • 3 serranos • ¼ white onion • 1 chile negro • 3 chile morita • 5 chile puya • 5–10 chile de árbol (adjust to your spice preference) • 4 raw garlic cloves • 1 bunch fresh cilantro • Salt to taste INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Char the tomatillos, tomatoes, serranos, and onion until softened and nicely blistered. 2. Toast the chile negro and chile morita until they puff slightly and become fragrant. 3. Lightly toast the chile puya and chile de árbol for just a few seconds, being careful not to burn them. 4. Add the dried chiles, tomatillos, and garlic to a blender. Blend until completely smooth. 5. Add the tomatoes, serranos, onion, cilantro, and salt. 6. Pulse until you reach your desired table-salsa consistency. 7. Taste and adjust salt if needed.

d: This one was an easy 9/10 from me. 🙌 Proper comfort food, packed with protein, ridiculously filling, and the slow cooker does basically all the work. ✅ What you’ll need * 500g 5% beef mince * 1 tin (390g) red kidney beans in chilli sauce * 850g sweet potato, diced * 150g sweetcorn * 1 packet chilli con carne seasoning * 1 tin (400g) chopped tomatoes * 250g mushrooms, sliced * 80g 30% reduced-fat cheddar cheese * Fresh coriander (optional) 👨‍🍳 How to make it 1️⃣ Add everything to your slow cooker except the cheese. Season with salt and african american pepper, then sprinkle over the chilli seasoning. 2️⃣ Mixy mixy motherfker!** Stir until everything is well combined. (You can brown the mince first if you want, but I skipped this step.) 3️⃣ Cook on High for 4 hours or Low for 7–8 hours. 4️⃣ Divide into 4 servings, then top each one with 20g reduced-fat cheddar. 5️⃣ Finish with some fresh coriander if you’re feeling fancy. Enjoy! 🌝 📊 Macros (Per Serving) 🔥 583 Calories 💪 46g Protein 🍠 86g Carbs 🥜 11g Fat Cheers @Dave Fell

d: Would you actually eat this street food? 😳 In this wild street food compilation, we explore some of the most unbelievable street food scenes from around the world. From massive woks full of noodles to busy street vendors cooking huge portions right in front of customers, this video shows the reality of street food markets and street food cooking that millions of people enjoy every day. Street food is famous for its bold flavors, fast cooking, and incredible variety. In many countries, street vendors prepare delicious meals in giant pans, sizzling grills, and steaming pots right on the street. But sometimes the cooking conditions can look a little questionable… which raises the big question — would you actually eat this street food? 🍜🔥 This street food video shows everything from huge noodle stir-fries and sizzling wok cooking to intense street kitchen action where vendors prepare food quickly for long lines of hungry customers. Street food markets are full of energy, heat, flames, and nonstop cooking that makes these food scenes fascinating to watch. Whether you love street food, enjoy food documentaries, or just want to see some unbelievable cooking moments, this street food compilation will definitely make you think twice. Some of these street food scenes look delicious… while others might make you wonder if you would really try it! 🤯 Let us know in the comments — would YOU eat this street food? 👇  #streetfood​ #shorts​ #food​

d: "Backroom Cleaners" is a four-player co-op roguelike shooter where you and your team are elite Axiom Corporation Cleaners deployed into the ever-shifting Backrooms—not to escape them, but to purge them. As specialized agents, your mission is to eliminate hostile entities, secure unstable zones, retrieve valuable samples, and push deeper into the endless maze of distorted rooms while containing the mysterious anomalies hidden within. (Steam Store) The game features class-based third-person combat, with each Cleaner bringing unique abilities that encourage teamwork and strategic coordination. Every expedition offers fresh build combinations through a roguelike progression system, allowing players to create powerful new loadouts while also unlocking permanent upgrades via a long-term skill tree. As you venture farther into the Backrooms, increasingly dangerous entities, procedurally generated encounters, and endlessly scaling difficulty ensure that no two runs play the same. (Steam Store) Developed by Hypercent Inc., "Backroom Cleaners" blends the eerie atmosphere of Backrooms horror with fast-paced cooperative action and roguelike progression. Instead of hiding from the horrors lurking in the liminal dimension, you become the hunters, turning one of the internet's most iconic horror settings into a combat-focused co-op experience. The game is currently targeting Q4 2026 in Early Access for PC, with console versions also planned. d: you hear a smoke alarm chirp once late at night— Don’t walk straight toward it. Stop in the hallway. Listen first. Because low batteries chirp regularly. They don’t usually chirp once. If the alarm chirps again but from a different room— Don’t start searching the house. And if the third chirp sounds closer than the first two— Don’t call out. Because people who ignored that rule all said the same thing later. The chirp didn’t come from the ceiling anymore. It came from somewhere lower. If the alarm suddenly chirps again right behind you in the hallway— Don’t turn around. Because smoke alarms are mounted to ceilings. But if the chirp keeps changing locations inside your house— It usually means something is carrying the sound room to room while you try to figure out where it’s coming from. ⸻ 🔎 KEYWORDS smoke alarm chirp horror story house alarm creepy encounter moving smoke alarm sound story home alone suspense story smoke detector night horror alarm sound moving house story home safety device horror house hallway suspense story smoke alarm thriller scenario inside house creepy sound story ⸻ HASHTAGS #FrankieBryant #ScaryStory #Storytelling #StayAware #NightProtocol
zh: 深夜听到烟雾报警器响了一声——别直接走过去。先停在走廊里，听仔细。因为电量不足会规律地响，通常不会只响一声。如果报警声再次响起却来自另一个房间——别开始搜索房子。如果第三声听起来比前两声更近——别出声呼喊。因为忽视这条规则的人事后都说了同一件事：那声响不再来自天花板，而是来自更低的地方。如果走廊正后方突然再次响起警报声——别回头。因为烟雾报警器是装在天花板上的。但如果那声响不断在屋内各处移动——通常意味着有什么东西正带着它在各个房间游走，而你还在试图判断声音从哪里来。

d: Why you should uncrust your crusty dog! 🫣 Leaving too much buildup on your dog for too long can cause irritation and discomfort for your pet. The best way to prevent this is with regular grooming, keeping the eyes clean and cleared, cleaning around the eyes daily with pet friendly eye wipes, and finding the source of the irritant. It’s also beneficial to look into things that support healthy tear production like filtered water and supplements. Always make sure to use a gentle facial cleanser to avoid irritating their eyes and face. My personal fav is @tropiclean Blueberry Facial - it’s a great way to gently and throughly clean your pet’s face. #dog #doggrooming #tips #cutedog #catthedoggroomer

d: Loaded Baked Potato Soup🥔 #soup #potato #potatoes #recipes #recipesforyou  Start out by chopping up 1 pound of bacon and cook it in a pot on medium heat.  Cook it until it’s nice and crispy and set it aside on a paper towel.  Remove some of the bacon grease from the pot leaving about 3 to 4 tablespoons in there.  Then add: -1 cup of diced onion -1 tablespoon of minced garlic Cook until the onions run clear and then add: -4 tablespoons of butter  Then once the butter is melted add: -1/3 cup of flour  And whisk it all together until smooth  Then slowly whisk in the following (slowly and a little bit at a time): -2 cups of 2% milk -1 cup of heavy whipping cream  -1/2 cup of sour cream  -3 cups of chicken broth  Once it comes to a simmer add: -4 cups worth of cooked and peeled potatoes. (I’m using the insides of the potato skins I made in my last video, but you can just boil and chop up some potatoes or bake some in the oven.)  Season to taste with: -chicken bouillon powder  -paprika -and salt and pepper Then add: -1 cup of freshly shredded cheddar cheese  -the majority of your crispy bacon (make sure to save a little for garnishing.)   Then serve once the cheese melts and top it off with: -a little more cheese -your bacon  -chives or green onion  -a dollop of sour cream  Enjoy💜

d: Eggnog recipe 👇🏼🎄 Eggnog feels like something you only see people drinking in 90s Christmas movies. But let me tell you, when I made this batch and took my first sip, I couldn’t believe it had taken me this long to try it for myself. Don’t let the ‘egg’ in the title put you off — it doesn’t taste eggy in the slightest, and in this version you make sure the egg is cooked, like you would with a custard. Eggnog 6 eggs 100 g caster sugar 750ml milk 250 ml cream 1/2 tsp nutmeg 1 cinnamon stick or 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon 1 tsp vanilla extract Meringue 180 g caster sugar Pinch salt Separate the eggs yolks from the whites and place the yolks in a large bowl with the caster sugar. Whisk together until the eggs are pale and fluffy. Add the milk, cream, nutmeg, cinnamon and vanilla to a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring well until the milk is hot but not boiling. Remove from the heat and discard the cinnamon stick. Next, temper the eggs — pour the milk little by little into the eggs, whisking well between each addition. This ensures the eggs don’t scramble! Once you’ve added all the milk, pour the mixture back into the saucepan and return to the heat until it’s nice and hot but not boiling. Remove from the heat and set aside. To make the meringue, add half the egg whites to a mixing bowl with the caster sugar and set over a pan of gently simmering water, whisking until the sugar is dissolved and the egg whites have reached 70ºC. This should take about 4-5 minutes — it’ll be hot to the touch. Remove from the heat and beat with an electric mixer for about 10 minutes or until it looks glossy and holds stiff peaks.  Pour the warm eggnog into mugs, spoon with meringue and finish by caramelising it with a blow torch (this is optional to give it that toasty flavour). #cookingfromscratch #wholesomefood #fromscratchcooking #christmasbaking #eggnog

Cheeseburger Rice is an easy one pan meal that can be made in less than 30 minutes for under $10!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb of ground beef  1 tsp each of paprika, oregano, garlic powder, onion powder  1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper 1 chopped onion 1 1/2 cups of beef broth  1 cup long grain white rice, rinsed  8 oz can of tomato sauce  1 tbsp minced garlic  1 1/2 cups of shredded Colby Jack cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Brown 1 lb of ground beef with chopped onion. Season with salt, pepper, paprika, oregano, garlic powder and onion powder.  Once the beef is browned, drain any extra grease if needed.  Add the minced garlic and stir.  Next, add the rinsed uncooked rice, beef broth, and tomato sauce to the skillet. Stir everything together well. Bring to a quick boil and turn heat down to low. Cover with a lid and cook for about 15 minutes stirring once or twice to keep the rice from sticking to the bottom of the pan.  Once the rice is cooked add about 1 cup of cheese and stir. Top with a little bit more cheese and let sit on the stove until the cheese melts or put it in the oven under broil for just a couple of minutes. Top with dried parsley. Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out!  #onepandinner #skilletdinner #groundbeef #easyrecipes

d: EASY MEALS FOR 2 EP. 14  ONE PAN DUMPLING LASAGNA BEFORE YOU COOK !! PLS READ * a lid for your pan is essential ! If you dont use a lid the pork won't steam / cook properly * the water + chicken boullion is importing, it not only adds flavour but allows the bottom to cook without burning ! ( the dumpling wrapper will kind of boil at first, but then you can remove the lid, let the water mixture evaporate and let the bottom crisp up )  Ingredients Pork Filling * 350 g ground pork * 2 green onions, finely chopped (about 42 g) * 100g Chinese leek, finely chopped * 1 tsp Better Than Bouillon Chicken Base * ¼ cup (60 mL) water Seasonings * 3 tbsp soy sauce * 1 tbsp oyster sauce * 1 tsp grated ginger * ½ tsp salt * ½ tsp black pepper * 1 tbsp sesame oil Assembly * 1–2 tbsp neutral oil * Dumpling wrappers (I used about 1 pack)  Steaming Liquid * ¼ cup (60 mL) water * ½ tsp Better Than Bouillon Chicken Base Chili Sauce * 1 tbsp soy sauce * 2 tbsp chili oil * ½ tsp sesame seeds Garnish * Chopped green onions Instructions 1. Make the Filling In a large bowl, combine: * Ground pork * Green onions * Chinese leek * Soy sauce * Oyster sauce * Ginger * Salt * Black pepper * Sesame oil Dissolve 1 teaspoon Better Than Bouillon in ¼ cup water, then pour it into the pork mixture. Mix everything vigorously for 2–3 minutes until the filling becomes sticky and the liquid is fully absorbed. 2. Assemble Add 1–2 tablespoons neutral oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat, layer the dumpling wrapper and filling like show. In the video.  3. Steam Mix together: * ¼ cup water * ½ teaspoon Better Than Bouillon Chicken Base Pour this mixture evenly throughout and around the edges of the pan. Cover with a lid. Cook over medium heat for about 8 minutes, or until the pork is fully cooked and the wrappers are tender. 4. Crisp the Bottom Remove the lid. Continue cooking for another 2–4 minutes, allowing any remaining liquid to evaporate and the bottom wrappers to become crisp. 5. Make the Sauce While the dumpling lasagna cooks, combine: * 1 tbsp soy sauce * 2 tbsp chili oil * ½ tsp sesame seeds 6. Serve Drizzle the chili sauce over the dumpling lasagna. Finish with plenty of chopped green onions and serve immediately. #creatorsearchinsights #dumplings #lasagna #DinnerIdeas #cooking

d: Sheet Pan Chicken Taco Lettuce Boats I forget how ridiculously good this recipe is every single time I make it. Crispy taco chicken, chili-lime street corn, all the cold toppings, and somehow you still feel like a functioning adult afterward instead of needing a nap. And yes, I used queso fresco. Mind your business.                    Ingredients For the chicken: * 2½ lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, chopped small * 2 packets taco seasoning * 1 teaspoon garlic powder * 1 teaspoon smoked paprika * Juice of 1 lime For the chili-lime corn: * 4 fresh ears of corn, kernels shaved off * ½ purple onion, diced * 1 tablespoon olive oil * 1 teaspoon chili powder * Salt to taste * Juice of ½–1 lime * ½ cup queso fresco * Fresh cilantro, chopped For serving: * Green leaf lettuce (sandwich cut) * Diced avocado * Pico de gallo * Jalapeño slices * Crema or Greek yogurt * Extra cilantro Instructions 1. Preheat oven to 425°F and line a sheet pan with parchment paper. 2. Toss chopped chicken with taco seasoning, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and lime juice. 3. Spread chicken onto one side of the sheet pan in an even layer. No oil needed. 4. Bake for 10 minutes. 5. Toss corn and purple onion with olive oil, chili powder, and salt. 6. Remove the pan, push chicken to one side, and add the corn mixture to the empty side. 7. Return to oven for another 10 minutes, then broil the last 3 minutes for crispy edges and charred corn. 8. Remove from oven and squeeze lime juice over the corn. Top with queso fresco and cilantro. 9. Assemble lettuce boats with chicken, street corn, avocado, pico, jalapeños, crema, and extra cilantro #taco #dinner #recipe #sheetpandinner #chicken

d: My Doctor Called My Wife I was told me my bloodwork looks like a Chick-fil-A receipt. So naturally I made fried chicken. When fried chicken is done right it needs to be crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside, and completely buried in garlic Parmesan butter. That’s non-negotiable. The secret is double dredging and letting it rest before it hits the oil. That’s what gives you the crust that actually stays on. Crunchy, garlicky, and something my doctor is going to find out about eventually. Worth it. 🧄 #recipe #friedchicken #garlicparmesan #chickentenders #foodie
